data.one_liner: CLI for creating and managing Dart/Flutter projects
data.what_it_does: The Very Good CLI provides commands to scaffold new Dart, Flutter, and plugin projects from templates, run tests with coverage, and manage package dependencies and licenses. It also offers an experimental MCP server for AI integration.
use_when: You need to quickly scaffold a new Dart or Flutter project
You want to run tests and collect coverage from the command line
You need to check licenses or fetch packages in a project
avoid_when: You are building a library that will be used as a dependency
You need a graphical interface for project setup
strengths: Fast, opinionated scaffolding for multiple project types
Integrated test runner with coverage and sharding
Built-in license checking and package management
weaknesses: Only a CLI tool, not a library for runtime use
Requires Dart SDK and global activation
Experimental MCP feature may be unstable
data.setup_notes: Run `dart pub global activate very_good_cli` and add the global bin to your PATH.
data.minimal_example:
```sh
# Create a new Flutter app
very_good create flutter_app my_app

# Run tests with coverage
very_good test --coverage
```
